meta.name: understand-dashboard
meta.description: Launch the interactive web dashboard to visualize a codebase's knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 可视化代码库知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要直观浏览代码库的结构和依赖关系。
copy.tagline_en: Visualize your codebase's knowledge graph interactively.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explore your codebase's structure and dependencies visually.

howto.what: 当你提出要求时，Claude 会启动一个网页仪表盘，展示当前项目的知识图谱。它自动查找相关文件、安装依赖并启动服务，最终返回带访问令牌的链接。
howto.when: 当你希望可视化项目的知识图谱，或要求“启动仪表盘”、“打开理解仪表盘”时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目的知识图谱可视化出来。
say.note: Claude 会启动仪表盘并返回链接。

say.text: 启动仪表盘查看代码库的关系图。
say.note: 适用已经分析过的项目。

say.text: 为当前项目打开理解仪表盘。
say.note: 如果项目未分析，会提示先运行 /understand。

howto.what_en: When you ask, Claude starts a web dashboard to visualize the current project's knowledge graph. It locates the dashboard code, installs dependencies, and launches a Vite dev server, then returns a tokenized URL.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to visualize the project's knowledge graph, or say 'start the dashboard' or 'open understand dashboard'.

say_en.text: Visualize the knowledge graph for this project.
say_en.note: Claude starts the dashboard and returns the URL.

say_en.text: Start the dashboard to see code relationships.
say_en.note: Works if the project has been analyzed.

say_en.text: Open the understand dashboard for this project.
say_en.note: If not analyzed, it will prompt to run /understand first.
